info.name: arTaH
info.note: kOmudyAm atra ucyate - 'jaya utkarzaprAptiH . akarmako'yam' .  ityukte, ayaM DAtuH 'utkarzaH' (prosperity) ityasmin arTe prayujyate, na hi 'winning/victory' ityasmin arTe . yaTA, 'jayatu saMskftam' ityasmin vAkye ayaM 'ji'-DAtuH prayuktaH asti, yataH atra 'saMskftasya utkarzaH Bavet' iti arTaH vivakzyate . 'Winning' asmin arTe tu (yaTA, rAmaH yudDaM jayati ityatra) ji (aBiBave) 1.1096 iti kaScana anyaH DAtuH prayoktavyaH . saH DAtuH sakarmakaH asti . atra nirdizwaH ji-DAtuH tu akarmakaH jYeyaH .

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: jayaH utkarzaprAptiH . akarmakoyam ' iti sidDAntakOmudI . mA.DA.vfttO api asya DAtoH akarmakatvam eva uktam . ' jayejjayABiBavayorAdyerTesAvakarmakaH . utkarzaprAptiH AdyerTe dvitIyerTe sakarmakaH ' (Slo. 13-14) iti dEvaSlokaH api atra upodbalakaH . kintu kfdantarUpamAlAyAM tu - ' jayaH - utkarza - prAptiH , aBiBavaSca . Adye akarmakaH dvitIye sakarmakaH iti paNktiH dfSyate .
